name: wasm-fuzzy-search
description: fzf-style fuzzy search index in Rust/WASM, differential-tested against a JS reference with identical data layout.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p web/pkg && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wasm.wasm web/pkg/fuzzy.wasm
scripts.bench: npm run build:wasm && npm run serve
